nodes.description: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules. Identify apparent relationships between corresponding terms. For example, know that 1 ft is 12 times as long as 1 in. Express the length of a 4 ft snake as 48 in. Generate a conversion table for feet and inches listing the number pairs (1, 12), (2, 24), (3, 36), ...

nodes.description: Interpret a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator (a/b = a ÷ b). set.scope: Understanding the ratio terms as relative part counts before allocating a total
